title: Barcelona hit with fresh injury blow ahead of Villarreal
snippet: La Liga giants Barcelona have early this week announced a fresh setback on the personnel front in the club’s defensive ranks. This comes amid confirmation that Pau Cubarsí has picked…
body: La Liga giants Barcelona have early this week announced a fresh setback on the personnel front in the club’s defensive ranks. This comes amid confirmation that Pau Cubarsí has picked up a knock. Stopper Cubarsí was for his part back in action on the international front on Sunday, as Spain locked horns with England in a Nations League clash. En route to an eventual 3-2 defeat for La Roja, though, the youngster was hooked from proceedings with 45 minutes on the clock, replaced by Dean Huijsen at the heart of Luis de la Fuente’s backline. And as since confirmed by Barcelona, this came owing to a fitness complaint. As per a statement across the Blaugrana’s official social media channels: ‘Pau Cubarsí is suffering from tightness in his hip flexor (iliopsoas). His recovery will determine whether he is available for the match against Villarreal.’ The 19-year-old will now be put through an individualised treatment plan back in Catalunya’s capital over the days ahead. ‼️ 𝐌𝐄𝐃𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐋 𝐍𝐄𝐖𝐒 Pau Cubarsí is suffering from tightness in his hip flexor (iliopsoas). His recovery will determine whether he is available for the match against Villarreal. pic.twitter.com/Tk4NCMdb5x Conor Laird – GSFN
summary_en: Barcelona confirmed Cubarsí picked up a knock while playing for Spain.

title: Mike Maignan withdrew from France game with hip injury
snippet: Mike Maignan (31) was forced off during France’s 2-1 win over Turkiye on Sunday night due to a hip injury, the FFF have confirmed in a statement. The AC Milan…
body: Mike Maignan (31) was forced off during France’s 2-1 win over Turkiye on Sunday night due to a hip injury, the FFF have confirmed in a statement. The AC Milan shotstopper started in Les Bleus ‘ match against Turkiye, the final game of their group stage campaign in the UEFA Nations League. However, he was in the wars in the first half, as we as being involved in a collision when sprinting off his line, he also sustained a hip injury and this is what ultimately forced Maignan off, the FFF have confirmed. It was Toulouse FC’s Guillaume Restes who came on for Maignan and saw out the rest of the encounter. The substitution was a precautionary measure and L’Équipe understands that he should be fit to face Frosinone in Serie A on Sunday evening. After the initial blow, the goalkeeper is already feeling better and should be back in training midway through this week, the publication adds. GFFN | Luke Entwistle
summary_en: Maignan came off with a hip injury for France, though the change was precautionary.

title: Bayern Munich’s Alphonso Davies sidelined with hamstring injury
snippet: Bayern Munich have announced that Alphonso Davies suffered a hamstring injury during the international break. The 26-year-old lasted just six minutes of Canada’s 3-2 win in Guatemala on Saturday. “Following…
body: Bayern Munich have announced that Alphonso Davies suffered a hamstring injury during the international break. The 26-year-old lasted just six minutes of Canada’s 3-2 win in Guatemala on Saturday. “Following a medical scan [Sunday] in Toronto, it has been confirmed that Alphonso Davies sustained a minor lower-body muscle strain. He is travelling back to Germany, where he will continue to receive ongoing care,” a Canada Soccer spokesperson informed Canadian Soccer Daily on Sunday evening . Bayern have since confirmed that Davies will face time on the sidelines, even though a clear duration was not mentioned. According to Bayern Munich reporter for TZ, Philipp Kessler , Davies will be out for 7-10 days. The plan is for him to return to the squad for the UEFA Champions League game in Lille next week, indicating that the injury isn’t serious. Davies has struggled for consistent playing time in the last couple of seasons because of muscular injuries, and has also sustained hamstring injuries back in April and March, keeping him out of crucial games. GGFN | Brook Genene
summary_en: Davies has a hamstring strain from Canada duty and will miss time.
